caso.texto:
A team practises visits in an approved fictional territory. One location posts no sales visits, another is serving a customer and a third allows one minute. The offer cannot activate immediately. The rep planned interior photographs without an approved evidence procedure.

An Indian business-premises exercise includes a reception-controlled entrance and a manager requesting a scheduled visit. Confirm language and timing; do not follow staff into restricted areas or photograph business records.

projeto.instrucoes: Plan the route, write three openings and endings and produce a visit record without exposing people or documents.
projeto.gabarito: Respect the notice and access control; do not demand attention during service. In the accepted minute, identify purpose and ask a relevant question. Promise no immediate activation and take no unauthorised photos. Record outcome and preferences.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
